Data & methods

This prototype shows how the twin will work. Only the ward and zone boundaries are real. Everything about the people is a synthetic population built from rules, so the software can be shown before real data arrives.

Privacy rules built in

Caste, health and nutrition are shown only as ward totals and are never attached to a person or a dot. India does not collect race, so there is no race layer. Religion is not modelled. In production, individual records would stay inside the data owner’s systems, and the twin would receive only aggregates above a minimum group size.

How the day simulation works

Each resident has a home, a destination, a travel mode and a departure time. Press play to run a day. Dots move along curved lines from home to work and back. These are straight-line desire lines, not road routes, because the road network is not loaded yet.
